title: Setup: build Spring Boot #51661 (S02) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S02 (spring-projects/spring-boot#51661: Resolve constructor defaults before type conversion). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S02-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of core:spring-boot with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (ValueObjectBinderTests (test) ConfigurationPropertiesTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of core:spring-boot in $P/artifacts/S02-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S02

resources.notes: Gradle daemon -Xmx3g with the Kotlin compiler in process, plus test JVMs; buildSrc and gradle/plugins compile once per worktree and once in the transplant copy (about 1 min each)

steps.name: S02 fix: build and landed tests
S02 parent: build and the parent's tests
S02 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
